correctness.rationale: The independent squares force pairwise disjoint coordinate supports for images of distinct basis elements; invertibility and the unit group of F2 give exactly simultaneous permutation stabilizers. For a transposition the rank-one square-zero part yields a commuting block matrix with determinant a^2 det(D). Its free entries give 2^(2n−3) times |GL_(n−2)| invertible centralizers, also at n=2 with |GL_0|=1. For support s and k moved cycles the ordered-pair orbit dimension is (n−s)^2+2(n−s)k+sum gcd(lambda_i,lambda_j), at most n^2−s(n−s/2). Summing over 3≤s≤n/2 gives O(n^3 2^(−9n/4)); the tail is 2^(−Omega(n^2)). Products of two distinct transpositions have codimension 4n−6 or 4n−8, giving a negligible Bonferroni error. The conditional event is therefore a unique transposition, not just an abstract group of order two.
residual_risks: Finite checks do not certify the asymptotic; the support and overlap estimates supply the proof. No Lean or expert attestation.
